scenario.selectAScenarioFileOnTheLeft: Select a scenario file on the left
ledger.empty: No ingest events yet — files, emails, calendars and recordings register here as they enter the understanding engine.
ledger.hint: The engine ledger for all ingest sources: pipeline routing, filter verdicts and memory writes. Wrongly blocked items can be reinstated; reinstatements feed the filter preference loop.
ledger.title: Title
ledger.filterPendingHint: The filter is judging; updates shortly
ledger.reinstateHint: Reinstate false positive: re-enter memory/Room/wiki pipelines
filterRules.unavailable: Filter rules are unavailable (filter gate disabled or request failed).
filterRules.preferenceHint: Rules here are injected into every filter decision (highest priority). Describe what should or should not enter the knowledge base, e.g. "keep all technical decisions" or "filter marketing emails".
filterRules.emptyPreference: (No preference set — the filter judges by generic rules only.)
filterRules.insightHint: Preference signals distilled hourly from your memory and wiki, for the filter's reference. Read-only; your own preference always wins on conflict.
filterRules.insightPending: Insight not generated yet (produced automatically about an hour after the service starts).
document.deleteCascadeHint: Deleting will also remove: the v{version} document itself, {chunks} chunks, and {memories} atomic memories (L1) derived from it, plus its conversation records (L0). This cannot be undone.
document.noDerivedMemoriesYet: No atomic memories have been extracted yet. Initial extraction runs asynchronously; refresh in a moment.
document.contentUnchanged: “{filename}” is unchanged and remains at version {version}.
document.versionUpgraded: “{filename}” was upgraded to {version}; memories from older versions were removed.
document.contentExceedsLimit: Content exceeds the 2 MB limit (currently {size} MB).
document.documentCount: {count} documents (reimporting the same name creates a new version)
document.titlePlaceholder: Document title (used for memory naming and deduplication)
document.importHint: Import Markdown as a memory source. MemoryCore chunks it by heading, extracts atomic memories, and preserves two-way provenance.
onboarding.questionWork: What do you mainly work on?
onboarding.hintWork: Describe your role, field, or a long-running project.
onboarding.placeholderWork: For example: I lead a product team and am currently building a knowledge workspace...
onboarding.questionFocus: What do you most want to move forward now?
onboarding.hintFocus: Share a near-term goal, a problem you are solving, or your current priority.
onboarding.placeholderFocus: For example: I am preparing the next release and need to balance quality with delivery speed...
onboarding.questionCollaboration: How should the Agent work with you?
onboarding.hintCollaboration: For example: lead with the answer, preserve technical detail, or proactively flag risks.
onboarding.placeholderCollaboration: For example: Be concise, identify risks early, and turn decisions into clear next steps...
settings.memorySetupBody: Memory setup appears automatically only on first use. Reopen it here whenever you need to refresh it.
settings.memorySetupActionBody: Refresh your work context, current focus, and collaboration preferences.
onboarding.serviceNotReadyBody: EverRoom could not reach the memory service. You can retry or continue without setup for now.
onboarding.consent: Your answers will be written to your memory library and refined using your current model configuration.
onboarding.savingBody: EverRoom is securely saving the context you provided.
onboarding.refiningBody: MemoryCore is turning your answers into a reusable memory.
onboarding.readyBody: EverRoom can now use this context in future conversations and workflows.
onboarding.backgroundMemoryReadyTitle: Your first long-term memory is ready
onboarding.backgroundMemoryReadyBody: Refinement finished in the background. You can review the new memory now.
onboarding.alreadyReadyBody: Continue using EverRoom, or go through the memory guide again.
onboarding.emptyBody: Give EverRoom a little context so it can start building a memory that is useful to you.
failure.unreachable: The MemoryCore service is temporarily unavailable.
failure.gatewayUnavailable: Memory data could not be loaded. Check that the gateway and MemoryCore are running.
writingStyle.sparseHint: Document samples are limited, so style guidance is minimal. Turning on either toggle backfills your existing documents automatically.
writingStyle.completionToggle: Apply in completion (editor ghost-text suggestions follow the style)
writingStyle.generationToggle: Apply in generation (document creation, edits and selection rewrite follow the style; plain conversation is unaffected)
writingStyle.systemSummaryHint: Computed automatically from your documents (read-only). Refreshes when documents change or are excluded.
writingStyle.emptyProfileHint: After turning on a toggle, existing documents are backfilled and the profile is derived automatically.
writingStyle.qualitativePending: (Qualitative summary pending: generated automatically once the corpus reaches 3 docs with enough new material)
writingStyle.emptyCorpus: (No corpus yet — existing documents are backfilled after enabling a toggle)
writingStyle.exclusionHint: Uncheck to exclude this document from the style corpus
writingStyle.contentPlaceholder: E.g. concise technical notes; end with short sentences; avoid exclamation marks; active voice for technical descriptions; paragraphs under 5 sentences…
writingStyle.emptyContent: (Empty — only the system-derived statistical reference is in effect)
writingStyle.profileTextHint: The profile is generated automatically from your documents; edit it directly on top. Once you save an edit the system stops overwriting it, and new corpus insights only prompt you to regenerate.
writingStyle.systemUpdateHint: New corpus insights are available — this is your taken-over version. "Regenerate from system" overwrites it with the latest profile (your edits will be lost).
writingStyle.sectionBehavior: Behavior preferences (your collaboration with the agent)
writingStyle.behaviorRevision: Personally revised agent output {count} times, average length change {percent}% (negative = shortened)
writingStyle.behaviorReview: Rejected {rejected} proposed edits in review (accepted {accepted}) — prefers rejecting off-target proposals over editing them
writingStyle.insightHint: After each round of document collaboration settles, the system distills the preferences you showed; confirm to write them into the profile above. Snoozed banners can be recovered here.
writingStyle.insightBannerTitle: New writing preferences distilled from this collaboration
writingStyle.offlineSnapshot: Offline snapshot (updated {time}) — gateway unreachable; refreshes automatically once it returns.
orgPrefs.unavailable: Organization preferences are unavailable (knowledge service not connected).
orgPrefs.switchesHint: Turning off learning stops stats and insight updates; turning off injection restores no-preference behavior for extraction and duplicate checks while keeping existing data.
orgPrefs.preferenceHint: Tell the system in one line how you organize knowledge (topic granularity, what counts as duplicate, filing habits). Takes priority over the system insight when injected; clear it to hand control back.
orgPrefs.emptyPreference: (Not set — the system insight still assists organization)
orgPrefs.insightHint: Distilled from your merge verdicts, routing corrections and recommendation decisions; refreshed hourly. Stays empty while samples are few.
orgPrefs.insightPending: (Too few samples yet, or learning is off)
orgPrefs.statsPending: (Learning is off, or no signals yet)
